title: 接手确认和下一次更新
premise: 技术边界与联系人均确认，明确21:00更新与提前触发条件。
listeningTask: 复述接班负责内容和无新证据时也必须更新的承诺。

lines.en: Just to recap, the next update is nine. That's local time on the incident record.
lines.zh: 小结一下，下次更新九点，按事件记录上的本地时区。

lines.en: I've got it from here on coordination. Two workers remain rerouted; primary diagnosis stays open.
lines.zh: 协调从这里我接手。两个工作进程维持绕行，主线诊断尚未结束。

lines.en: Okay, the mitigation is holding for those workers. Saved configurations and evidence references are attached.
lines.zh: 好，这些工作进程缓解仍有效。已附保存配置和证据引用。

lines.en: I'll request the carrier's pending diagnostic update. No reply still becomes an explicit status.
lines.zh: 我会索取运营商尚未给出的诊断更新。未回复也会明确报状态。

lines.en: I'll monitor reconciliation and both client groups. Any correctness issue gets an immediate page.
lines.zh: 我监控核对和两类客户端。任何正确性问题立即呼叫。

lines.en: Just to confirm, threshold breaches update earlier, right? Don't wait for the scheduled nine.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，超过门槛要提前更新，对吧？不等计划九点。

lines.en: Correct, and routing changes need capacity assessment. We won't automatically restore the primary path.
lines.zh: 对，路由变化需评估容量，不自动恢复主路径。

lines.en: If asked what's the ETA, distinguish diagnosis. We still have no repair estimate.
lines.zh: 被问预计多久时要区分诊断，目前仍没有修复时间估计。

lines.en: Understood, ticket evidence before any recovery claim. Quiet probes alone won't close this incident.
lines.zh: 明白，宣称恢复前需要工单证据。探测平静不能单独关闭事件。

lines.en: So, handoff accepted at roughly eight forty-five. Update at nine even without new findings.
lines.zh: 因此大约八点四十五接受交接。即使没有新发现，九点也更新。
